bounded_review: Pinned Qt6.12 disableSurface branch with null focused surface warns and returns before disable/commit/state changes. Filter changes console output only; general focus/IME correctness is not claimed.

Only QtWarningMsg, exact Wayland textinput category/function-message prefix/null-focus suffix and bounded nonzero ASCII hex pointer match. Enabled-surface mismatch, nonnull focus, other text/categories/severities/context are forwarded. Native install is disabled outside qVersion6.12.0.

main_desktop installs once before QApplication and before service/Qt-thread startup. The previous handler pointer is then immutable under this startup-only contract; later explicit handler installation supersedes this wrapper. No runtime reinstall or polling.

Read-only pinned QtCore disassembly independently confirms qInstallMessageHandler returns the actual previous pointer or real default, so forwarding preserves Qt output formatting and custom-handler semantics without a default-handler approximation.

Startup explicit diagnostics/fatal-warning/log-format/log-rules/log-config environment controls bypass native and preview filtering, including empty Qt variables. QtFatal/critical/other levels remain forwarded unchanged; no fatal/environment/category rules are rewritten.

Existing preview byte filtering is unchanged except the added explicit logging opt-outs. Its Qt6.12 applicability remains the existing pinned dependency contract; the new native filter separately gates exact runtime version.
Focused tests exercise forwarding/matching and startup env controls with RAII restoration; existing smoke bodies remain exact. Tests have not been run by this reviewer.
limitations: No compiler, tests, GUI, network or native mutation. Real Wayland focus/international-input acceptance remains root-owned.
Opt-outs are evaluated at startup, as documented; this is not a dynamic logging-configuration watcher.
No general claim that all Wayland warnings or future Qt versions are harmless.
